qa.name: Supinator
qa.origin: Lateral epicondyle of the humerus, radial collateral ligament, annular ligament, supinator crest of the ulna
qa.insertion: Lateral surface of the proximal third of the radius
qa.innervation: Deep branch of the radial nerve (posterior interosseous nerve)
qa.function: Supination of the forearm at all elbow positions
qa.clinical_note: The deep branch of the radial nerve passes through the arcade of Frohse between the two heads of supinator — compression causes posterior interosseous nerve syndrome with finger and thumb drop

qa.name: Abductor Pollicis Longus
qa.origin: Posterior surface of the ulna and radius and the interosseous membrane
qa.innervation: Posterior interosseous nerve (deep branch of the radial nerve)
qa.function: Abduction and extension of the thumb at the carpometacarpal joint
qa.clinical_note: Its tendon runs in the first extensor compartment with extensor pollicis brevis — stenosing tenosynovitis of this compartment is called de Quervain tenosynovitis

qa.name: Extensor Pollicis Brevis
qa.origin: Posterior surface of the radius and interosseous membrane
qa.insertion: Base of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
qa.innervation: Posterior interosseous nerve (deep branch of the radial nerve)
qa.function: Extension of the metacarpophalangeal joint of the thumb, abduction of the wrist
qa.clinical_note: Runs with abductor pollicis longus in the first extensor compartment — both tendons form the lateral border of the anatomical snuffbox

qa.name: Extensor Pollicis Longus
qa.origin: Posterior surface of the middle third of the ulna and interosseous membrane
qa.insertion: Base of the distal phalanx of the thumb
qa.innervation: Posterior interosseous nerve (deep branch of the radial nerve)
qa.function: Extension of the interphalangeal joint of the thumb, extension and adduction of the thumb at the carpometacarpal joint
qa.clinical_note: Forms the medial border of the anatomical snuffbox — its tendon wraps around Lister's tubercle and can rupture spontaneously after distal radius fractures

qa.name: Extensor Indicis
qa.origin: Posterior surface of the distal third of the ulna and interosseous membrane
qa.insertion: Extensor expansion of the index finger
qa.innervation: Posterior interosseous nerve (deep branch of the radial nerve)
qa.function: Independent extension of the index finger at the metacarpophalangeal joint
qa.clinical_note: Allows independent pointing with the index finger — commonly harvested for tendon transfer surgery to restore thumb extension after extensor pollicis longus rupture
